question.problem:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$2$** | **$4$** | **$6$** | **$8$** | **$10$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$10$** | **$7$** | **$5$** | **$3$** | **$2$** |
| $y$ | $-4$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $8$ | $12$ |

The vector of coefficients of the plane $y={\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}$ that best fits the data above can be found using multiple linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?
question.worked_solution:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$2$** | **$4$** | **$6$** | **$8$** | **$10$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$10$** | **$7$** | **$5$** | **$3$** | **$2$** |
| $y$ | $-4$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $8$ | $12$ |

The coefficients of the plane 

$$
y={\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}
$$

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}2 & 10 \\ 4 & 7 \\ 6 & 5 \\ 8 & 3 \\ 10 & 2\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ -1 \\ 0 \\ 8 \\ 12\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

 

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
